cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've decided we're not circling this station again. I avoid my old office too. Who are you avoiding?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My former boss catches this train. May we keep walking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Permission pending. I told mine I'd become a novelist. What did you tell yours?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That I had a better offer. Can we take the next street?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After one answer. I've carried a blank notebook past mine for a year. Was there really a better offer, or am I authorizing a detour to protect a story like mine?

reason: Make A withhold permission to continue the detour while using successive confessions to test B's reason, without asserting the offer was false.
